# betterado_accounts (Data Source)

Use this data source to list Azure DevOps accounts accessible to the authenticated user.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List all accounts accessible to the authenticated user
data "betterado_accounts" "all" {}

output "account_names" {
  value = [for a in data.betterado_accounts.all.accounts : a.account_name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `member_id` (String) Filter accounts by member subject descriptor (UUID). If omitted, all accounts accessible to the authenticated PAT are returned.

### Read-Only

- `accounts` (Attributes List) The list of ADO accounts accessible to the authenticated user. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--accounts))
- `id` (String) The data source ID.

<a id="nestedatt--accounts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `accounts`

Read-Only:

- `account_id` (String) The UUID identifier of the account.
- `account_name` (String) The name of the account (organization name slug).
- `account_type` (String) The type of account: personal or organization.
- `account_uri` (String) The URI of the account.
- `organization_name` (String) The organization name associated with the account.
